note: Paraphrase augmentation for the v6 retrain (2026-11-13). Each entry rewords an existing instruction question while keeping the same response, so the model learns each fact under several phrasings instead of memorising one question-to-answer mapping. None of these paraphrases matches a held-out val question or a probe question in eval/finetune-probe-v5.jsonl; that is checked by tools/add_paraphrases.py before appending. The probe file must stay unseen and is never used as training data.
